title: A matching game for the block party

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: For the block party, children should play the matching game without being shown which drawer to open. The cards from last year say “Find the same mark.” We can still use those. The hall game’s off, so we’ll use its drawer here.
turns.zh: 街坊派對上，小朋友玩配對遊戲時，不能有人指給他們看該開哪個抽屜。去年的卡片寫著「找出相同的記號」，還能用。大廳的遊戲取消了，所以我們會把大廳那組的抽屜加進來。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: The green set is just printed. The yellow set has just raised shapes you can feel, but Sam mixed up the star and the flower.
turns.zh: 綠色那組只有印刷圖文，黃色那組只有可以用手摸的凸起圖案，但山姆把星星和花朵搞混。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: He took his glasses off for that round. He could match both shapes when he rested the board flat. On the wall he had to hold each card up with one hand and feel the mark with the other.
turns.zh: 那一輪他把眼鏡拿掉了。他把板子平放後，兩個圖案都能配對。板子掛在牆上時，他得一手舉著卡，另一手摸記號。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: The little table is where parents sign in. The spare bench is clear and low enough. Could we set up a practice pair with no mark from the live game?
turns.zh: 小桌子是家長簽到用的。備用長椅空著，高度也合適。可以找一個正式遊戲沒有的圖案，做一組練習配對嗎？

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Two cards per mark. The star stays, but I took out the flower drawer: broken handle. The hall drawer’s the moon.
turns.zh: 每種圖案各有兩張卡。星星留著，但花朵抽屜的把手壞了，我把它拿掉了。大廳那個是月亮圖案。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Good. I won’t put them together until everyone has had a chance to try.
turns.zh: 好，我會等每個人都有機會試過之後，才把這兩張配在一起。
